display.title: Episode 257: Little Zalmy and the Spooky House, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi tours the Shabbos Candlestick Contest drawings in the newsletter, two brothers lead the Shema, and the mystery of the spooky house is solved by young Schneur Zalman's secret Torah class.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi walks listeners through page two of the new Tzivos Hashem newsletter, describing the Shabbos candle drawings sent in for the contest: whole Shabbos tables, challah covers, and one entry that explains the candles bring the light of Torah and mitzvos into the world. After the Hakochainik march, two brothers lead the Shema in Studio 604. Story time concludes Little Zalmy and the Spooky House: the footsteps Shimmy and Zelig feared were robbers turn out to be a group of children led by their classmate Schneur Zalman. The abandoned house is his secret classroom, where he teaches children who never went to cheder about Hashem and brachos, sharing baskets of treats. He comforts Meir, a poor boy who must help at home, teaching that Hashem treasures every letter a child learns and that helping parents is part of the Torah. The two boys decide to gather children to learn as well, and Uncle Yossi reveals that the young hero grew up to be the Alter Rebbe. The show ends with a sponsor message and Chanukah wishes.
display.lesson: Ahavas Yisroel means sharing what you have and helping other children learn about Hashem, Torah and mitzvos; Hashem treasures every letter a child learns.

date.note: Sponsor ad for Chanukah gifts and 'a happy Chanukah to all of you'; one week after episode 256 (candle lighting 19 Dec 1986). Chanukah 5747 began Friday night, 26 Dec.
